recap:
Joe Rogan brings on the full Legion of Skanks crew for what turns into a free-flowing conversation about comedy, podcasting, and the current state of the entertainment industry. Big Jay Oakerson, Luis J. Gomez, and Dave Smith have built a massive following through their podcast on the GaS Digital Network, and this episode dives into how they've managed to stay relevant and keep their audience engaged in an increasingly saturated podcast landscape.

The guys don't hold back discussing the challenges of being comedians in today's environment. They touch on how the comedy community has evolved, the way audiences consume content now versus years ago, and what it takes to maintain authenticity while building a sustainable career. There's plenty of banter and the kind of unfiltered conversation you'd expect from three comedians who've spent years riffing together.

The episode showcases why the Legion of Skanks has such a dedicated fanbase. These guys have chemistry, they're not afraid to go deep on topics, and they understand how to keep an audience entertained for hours. Joe and the Skanks dig into various stories from their touring experiences, what it's like performing in different markets, and how they approach their comedy from a business standpoint.

Throughout the conversation, there's an underlying theme about staying true to your comedic voice while navigating the modern media landscape. They discuss their individual brands, how they've each built their platforms, and what keeps them motivated to keep grinding. It's the kind of shop talk that comedy fans eat up because it gives real insight into how these guys actually work and think about their craft.
